_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Thirty-seventh scheduled run. 16 of 20 URLs served and 10,312 product pages reviewed, slightly down on yesterday's 10,346 because two sellers shrank their catalogs. NO NEW MATCHES against the chart anywhere.

TWO CATALOGS CONTRACTED. Flower Meadow Dream fell 216 -> 183 products (33 gone) and Hillside Rose Farm 171 -> 158 (13 gone). Neither drop took a listing we track beyond the ones already recorded as removed, and nothing else changed about either site: both served normally and in full. Noted because a catalog losing that much in one run is worth seeing, not because anything follows from it.

HILLSIDERO-005 is gone again, confirmed HTTP 404, one run after returning -- the shortest it has stayed listed yet, and its seventh disappearance since 2026-10-19. Seven listings now stand removed, each confirmed by HTTP 404: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001, HILLSIDERO-004, HILLSIDERO-005 and SPRINGLAND-004. 397 of 404 cases verified present; nothing was left unchecked.

Still outstanding with the user from the 2026-11-02 run: whether to apply the more-specific-chart-name rule to the 28 existing cases it would change. The matcher itself is fixed and today's run used it; only the backlog is untouched. None of the 28 changes enforceability group.

Mola Rose and Muse Roses reported identical catalog sizes and identical match counts for the sixth consecutive run (781 / 42 each). Still flagged, still not acted on.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Served at 216 products, unchanged. MYROSEWORL-001..003 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 174 products, unchanged. HILLSIDERO-005 still present; -004 still removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.
Shopify storefront; the store's own product feed answered normally and returned zero products. The catalog is empty, not unreachable -- the site was checked in full.
Served at 62 products, unchanged. KATEROSES-001 and -002 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Served at 1,943 products, up 56 from 2026-10-26 and 88 over three runs. None of the additions matched a chart name.

screenshot_limitation: 351 of 404 cases carry a screenshot. The 53 without one each record why: High Garden 47 (8 Registered) -- the seller's pages blank themselves on detecting an automated browser, so these need manual capture and the measure was not bypassed; One Love 3 (1 Registered) -- a membership login wall, also not bypassed; Flower Meadow Dream 3 -- listings removed, HTTP 404.
